payload.title: Staging build cannot find amplify_outputs.json: papyrus resolves PAPYRUS_ROOT inside the venv, not the checkout
payload.description: CMS staging job 1 (app dv0pdx67fk80m, branch staging) failed at `papyrus ops content export-published --drafts` with "Missing amplify_outputs.json". The cutover note blamed a missing backend association; the build log shows that message ("No backend environment association found, continuing") is benign, and that `npx ampx generate outputs --branch main --app-id $AWS_APP_ID` DID write amplify_outputs.json into the checkout. Root cause: a pip-installed papyrus resolves PAPYRUS_ROOT (src/papyrus_content/env.py) to a directory inside the venv, so it never looks at the checkout. Fix: run the two staging papyrus commands with PAPYRUS_ROOT="$PWD" in the template cms-staging build spec (infra/amplify-app-shell/lib/build-specs.ts), plus synth test. Staging keeps sharing main backend.
